name: ThankRedirect – Custom Thank You Page for WooCommerce
author: WPKIN

sections.description:
ThankRedirect transforms the standard WooCommerce thank you page into a powerful marketing tool that helps you increase customer satisfaction, boost repeat purchases, and maximize your store’s conversion potential.

Instead of the default, bland WooCommerce thank you page, redirect customers to fully customized thank you pages tailored to their specific purchase, customer role, or other criteria.

Why Your Store Needs a Custom Thank You Page

The thank you page is a critical but often overlooked touchpoint in the customer journey. It’s the moment when customers are most engaged with your brand – they’ve just completed a purchase and are excited about their decision.

With ThankRedirect, you can:

  • Increase customer satisfaction with personalized thank you messages
  • Reduce post-purchase anxiety by providing clear order information
  • Generate additional sales through targeted product recommendations
  • Boost customer retention with loyalty program promotions
  • Improve marketing ROI with conversion tracking pixels

Free Features

  • Global Thank You Page Redirect – Set a default custom thank you page for all orders
  • Product-Specific Redirects – Create unique thank you pages for specific products
  • Category-Based Redirects – Direct customers to different thank you pages based on product categories
  • Dynamic Order Information – Display order details with shortcodes
  • Page Builder Compatible – Works with Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and other popular page builders
  • Easy Setup – Simple, intuitive interface for setting up redirects

Powerful Shortcodes (Free Version)

Display dynamic order information on your thank you pages with these built-in shortcodes:

  • [wpkin_order_number] – Shows the customer’s order number
  • [wpkin_transaction_id] – Displays the transaction ID
  • [wpkin_order_status] – Shows the current order status
  • [wpkin_order_created_date] – Displays the order creation date
  • [wpkin_customer_name] – Shows the customer’s full name

Pro Features

Upgrade to ThankRedirect Pro for advanced customization options:

  • User Role Based Redirects – Different thank you pages based on customer roles
  • Payment Method Based Redirects – Customize thank you pages based on how customers pay
  • Product Type Based Redirects – Specific thank you pages for different product types
  • Product Tag Based Redirects – Direct customers based on product tags
  • Product Brand Based Redirects – Create brand-specific thank you experiences
  • Product Variation Based Redirects – Different thank you pages for product variations
  • URL Personalization – Add dynamic parameters to your thank you page URLs
  • eCommerce DataLayer for Analytics – Enhanced tracking for Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel
  • Redirect Delay – Set a timed delay before redirecting customers

Pro Shortcodes

The Pro version includes additional shortcodes for creating highly detailed thank you pages:

Order Information:
* [wpkin_order_total] – Total order amount
* [wpkin_total_price] – Subtotal before tax and shipping
* [wpkin_tax] – Tax amount
* [wpkin_shipping] – Shipping cost
* [wpkin_currency] – Currency symbol
* [wpkin_coupon] – Applied coupon codes

Customer Information:
* [wpkin_customer_name] – Customer’s full name
* [wpkin_first_name] – Customer’s first name
* [wpkin_customer_email] – Customer’s email address
* [wpkin_billing_phone] – Customer’s phone number
* [wpkin_billing_address] – Complete billing address
* [wpkin_shipping_address] – Complete shipping address

Product Information:
* [wpkin_items] – List of purchased products
* [wpkin_item_count] – Number of items purchased
* [wpkin_downloads] – Download links for digital products

Shipping & Payment:
* [wpkin_payment_method] – Payment method used
* [wpkin_shipping_method] – Shipping method selected

Use Cases

  • Create upsell opportunities by recommending complementary products
  • Encourage social sharing with pre-populated social media buttons
  • Offer special discounts for the next purchase
  • Display video tutorials related to purchased products
  • Collect feedback with embedded surveys
  • Promote your loyalty program to increase retention
  • Provide detailed delivery information to reduce support inquiries

Who Should Use ThankRedirect?

  • Online retailers looking to maximize customer lifetime value
  • Digital product sellers wanting to provide immediate access to purchases
  • Subscription businesses needing to communicate next steps
  • Service providers looking to set proper expectations after purchase
  • Dropshippers wanting to provide transparent shipping information
  • Marketers seeking to improve conversion tracking and analytics

Documentation and Support

For detailed setup instructions, visit our documentation.

If you need assistance, our support team is ready to help at support@wpkin.com.

Additional Information

For more information about ThankRedirect and our other plugins, visit WPKin.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/thank-redirect directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → ThankRedirect to configure your thank you page settings.
sections.faq:
Will this work with my theme?

Yes! ThankRedirect works with any WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce.

Can I use different thank you pages for different products?

Absolutely! You can set up product-specific thank you pages in the free version, and even more granular control with the Pro version.

How do I display order information on my thank you page?

Use our built-in shortcodes like [wpkin_order_number] and [wpkin_customer_name] to display dynamic order information.

Will this slow down my website?

No. ThankRedirect is lightweight and optimized for performance. The redirects happen quickly and won’t impact your site’s speed.

Can I use this with page builders like Elementor?

Yes! ThankRedirect works seamlessly with all major page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and the WordPress block editor.

Does this work with WPML or other multilingual plugins?

Yes, ThankRedirect is compatible with WPML and other popular multilingual plugins, allowing you to create thank you pages in multiple languages.

Can I track conversions with Google Analytics or Facebook Pixel?

The Pro version includes enhanced eCommerce DataLayer support for accurate conversion tracking with Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel.

What happens if something goes wrong with the redirect?

If any issues occur, customers will see the default WooCommerce thank you page, ensuring they always receive their order confirmation.
